# Pushify

> Pushify is an open-source cloud deployment platform that lets developers
> deploy web applications to their own VPS servers in under 60 seconds,
> without configuration. Unlike Vercel or Netlify, Pushify runs on servers
> you own — provisioned through Hetzner Cloud or any custom VPS — so your
> data never touches third-party infrastructure. MIT-licensed. Supports 20+
> frameworks including Next.js, React, Vue.js, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, Remix,
> Node.js, Python, Go, and Laravel.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://pushify.dev): Platform overview and value proposition
- [Features](https://pushify.dev/features): Full feature set — deploy, servers, databases, CLI, monitoring
- [Pricing](https://pushify.dev/pricing): Free tier and Pro plans
- [Docs](https://pushify.dev/docs): REST API reference, authentication, CI/CD integration
- [Open Source](https://pushify.dev/open-source): MIT license, self-hosting, contribution guide
- [About](https://pushify.dev/about): Company background, mission, values
- [GitHub](https://github.com/pushifydev): Source code, issues, contributions

## Core Features

- Push-to-deploy from GitHub with framework auto-detection
- Managed VPS servers via Hetzner Cloud (5+ regions) or custom servers
- One-click databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB with automated backups
- CLI tool for terminal-based deployments (npm: pushify-cli)
- Automatic SSL certificates via Let's Encrypt
- Zero-downtime deploys with instant rollbacks
- Team collaboration and role-based access
- Marketplace with 24+ ready-to-deploy apps (WordPress, Supabase, Appwrite, etc.)
- Real-time monitoring and server metrics

## Alternatives Comparison

Pushify is comparable to Vercel, Railway, Render, and Coolify, with the
key distinction of running on user-owned infrastructure. Unlike managed
platforms, Pushify gives developers full control over their servers and data.

## CLI Installation

```
npm install -g pushify-cli
```
